propositions: reduce_ticket opens all matching event files on every call, causing 4,977 file opens and 11,181 listdir calls per pending_enrichment gate check, exceeding the 20ms budget consistently (measured 404-654ms on production tracker)
queue event filenames encode monotonic timestamp prefixes in fixed-width format that match the event body's timestamp field, enabling lexicographic ordering to determine recency
_latest can read only the newest matching event file per type with fallback to older files on parse failure, reducing per-ticket file opens from unbounded to at most one per type

claim arbitration can skip pre-enqueue CLAIM events by stopping the newest-first walk once encountering a filename timestamp <= the latest ENQUEUE timestamp, bounding reads by contention window rather than history
the optimization changes no on-disk behavior (no deletion, rename, or writes), preserving concurrency invariants and cross-clone union merges
a corrupt newest event file must fall back gracefully to the next-older file in the newest-first walk
